test.name: Image cap refusal — relay it to the caller verbatim (direct-agent arm)
test.description: Handoff U25: a delegated image read must pass the hard image cap's refusal (#3010) back to its caller. image_transcribe throws the real refusal for a 21st distinct image in group 004452257 (pinned to browse-budget.ts by tests/packaging/image-cap-fixture.test.ts). image-reader holds only image_transcribe, so it cannot log the partial browse or move to other routes itself; its return is the only way those instructions reach the caller.

input.delegation:
Read this page scan and transcribe it.

imageId: 004452257_00021
looking_for: a burial entry for Patrick Flynn, 1882
project_path: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own return.
image_transcribe answers with an isError result: the hard image cap refused the image before fetching it. Nothing on the page was read.

THE POINT OF THIS TEST: the refusal's text tells the CALLER what to do next (log the browse as partial with research_log_append, move to other routes, name the unfinished browse with its link in the final summary). image-reader cannot do any of that itself. Score PASS when the return carries `NOT READ: 004452257_00021` and quotes the refusal with its link and instructions intact. Score FAIL when it paraphrases the instructions away, drops the link, presents any transcription or extracted facts, or calls image_transcribe again.
